caption: The drawing depicts a figure standing on a square pedestal. The figure is dressed in a white long-sleeved shirt with red cuffs and a low neckline, a red skirt with a gold trim, a blue sash tied at the waist with a gold border, and white stockings. The shoes are yellow with a small heel. The figure wears a large, wide-brimmed hat in green and yellow with decorative elements, positioned atop curly dark hair. The figure holds two mallets with round brown heads and long black handles, one in each hand, crossed in front of the body. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery depicted.
title: Carousel Drummer Girl
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
